# Tiffany Venegas, LCSW

> Tiffany Venegas, MSW, LCSW (California license #130210) is a licensed therapist offering online therapy (telehealth) for teens and adults anywhere in California. Her work is grounded in ACT, CBT and DBT. Sessions are $140 for 55 minutes, and new clients start with a free 20-minute consultation.

## Who she works with

- Teens and adults in California, by telehealth only (no in-person sessions)
- High-functioning overthinkers: the person everyone relies on who looks put-together while quietly burning out

## Specialities

- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Trauma-informed care
- Anxiety and ADHD
- Life transitions

## Practical details

- Fee: $140 for a 55-minute session; most clients start weekly
- Insurance: out of network; she can provide a superbill for possible out-of-network reimbursement
- Good Faith Estimate provided before the first session
- Education: B.A. Psychology, University of San Francisco; Master of Social Welfare, UCLA

## Links

- [Website](https://www.tiffanyvenegaslcsw.com): bio, approach, specialities and FAQ
- [Request a free consultation](https://tiffanyvenegaslcsw.clientsecure.me): secure SimplePractice client portal for booking and messages
- In a mental health crisis, call 988
